'''Asset I-4''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="State" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> I-4 was dispatched by the Shroud to investigate the recent deaths of Assets [[Asset I-12|I-12]], [[Asset I-32|I-32]], and [[Asset I-40|I-40]].<ref name="State" />
